name: opsflow
description: OpsFlow - SaaS B2B de gestion d'incidents et automatisation des workflows

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/api && npm run lint --workspace=apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=packages/shared && npm run test --workspace=apps/api
